rows.name: Tortolita to DeMoss Petrie portion
rows.quote: This project will be constructed in phases with an expected in-service date of Q4 2026 for the Tortolita to DeMoss Petrie portion of the project

rows.name: DeMoss Petrie to Vail portion
rows.quote: This project will be constructed in phases with an expected in-service date of Q4 2026 for the Tortolita to DeMoss Petrie portion of the project, and an expected in-service date of Q4 2027 for the DeMoss Petrie to Vail portion of the project.

rows.name: Roadrunner Reserve Battery Energy Storage System
rows.quote: Roadrunner Reserve Battery Energy Storage System: TEP plans to add a 400MW Battery Energy Storage System connected at 138kV to the Vail substation.
rows.in_service_raw: expected to be placed in service in 2026

rows.name: Tortolita 500/138 kV Transformer Addition
rows.quote: Tortolita 500/138 kV Transformer Addition: TEP plans to add a fourth 500/138 kV transformer at Tortolita substation to be operated in parallel to the existing transformers. The purpose of this transformer addition is to increase import capability into the TEP Load Pocket to accommodate increased forecasted load. The expected in- service date for this project is 2031.

rows.name: Vail 345/138 kV Transformer Addition
rows.quote: Vail 345/138 kV Transformer Addition: TEP plans to add a fourth 345/138 kV transformer at Vail substation to be operated in parallel to the existing transformers. The purpose of this transformer addition is to increase import capability into the TEP Load Pocket to accommodate increased forecasted load. The expected in-service date for this project is 2033.

rows.name: Pinal West 500/345 kV Transformer Addition
rows.quote: Pinal West 500/345 kV Transformer Addition: TEP plans to add a third 500/345 kV transformer at Pinal West substation to be operated in parallel to the existing transformers. The purpose of this transformer addition is to increase import capability into the TEP Load Pocket to accommodate increased forecasted load. The expected in- service date for this project is 2035.

rows.name: UNSE Black Mountain Generating Station Expansion
rows.quote: UNSE plans to add four 50 MW Gas-Fired generation units for a total of 200 MW at the existing Black Mountain Generating Station in Mohave County, Arizona. A 230 kV line will connect this new generation to Western Area Power Administration (WAPA)’s Griffith substation in Mohave County.

rows.name: UNSE Golden Valley 230kV Transmission Line
rows.quote: UNSE Golden Valley 230kV Transmission Line UNSE plans to construct a new 230kV transmission line in Mohave County from the WAPA’s McConnico 230 kV substation to the planned UNSE Mineral Park 230 kV substation.
